pluginMetaData.name: ASTM E1381 Transmission Mode
pluginMetaData.author: Bit Dream IT
pluginMetaData.description: ASTM E1381-02 lower-layer transmission framing protocol, client side. Provides the settings panel (Frame Settings, Validation Settings, Connection Settings, Mode) used by channel authors when configuring an ASTM E1381 destination connector. Also provides the client-side TransmissionModeClientProvider that exposes the sample messages and property-validation hooks for the Mirth channel editor.
